sources.source_role_and_hypotheses: Definitions in section 3.1, Theorems 1.1 and 1.6, Theorem 3.8 and section 10 were assessed. Strictly developable/simple hypotheses, thinness where applicable, classifying-space hypotheses and strict fundamental domains cannot be dropped. Outer-space and punctured-surface Teichmuller spines do not supply the target strict domain.
